title: Ghost route attenuator: metered mirroring proxy with tenant credit fencing
creator: Marco Li
description: Introduce a lightweight mirroring proxy ("ghost-route attenuator") that duplicates a bounded subset of production traffic to candidate model backends while preventing uncontrolled cost/latency and ensuring tenant safety. The proxy will: (1) perform adaptive sampling per-tenant, (2) enforce a tenant credit fence and global cost cap, (3) route mirrored traffic to isolated replica pools (no shared KV cache), and (4) emit detailed telemetry for per-token chargeback and model comparison metrics. This enables safer shadow experiments (canary rollouts, A/B) without creating billing surprises or noisy interference with live workloads.
problem_statement: Current mirroring solutions can blow past cost budgets, pollute KV caches, and risk tenant performance by sending unbounded duplicates. Teams need a way to run long-running shadowing experiments and retrospective A/B evaluations with predictable economics and safety nets for multi-tenant production.
goals: Safe duplication: avoid unbounded resource consumption and isolate mirrored requests from production KV caches and memory-sensitive paths.
Metered sampling: provide adaptive sampling (percent + reservoir + time-window) with per-tenant credit accounting and global circuit breaker.
Observability: per-tenant/per-model token and latency breakdowns plus end-to-end correlation ids for comparison dashboards.
Graceful failure: automatic demotion/rollback of mirroring for a tenant when cost or error thresholds are exceeded.
Operator ergonomics: simple config in YAML/console and API for enabling mirroring rules, quotas, and scheduled windows.
non_goals: Full traffic replay/backfill engine (out of scope; use analytic replay infra),
Model training integrations (only inference mirroring and telemetry).
design_decisions: Lease-based mirroring tokens per-tenant: each tenant gets a small ephemeral credit lease renewed by billing service to avoid stale open mirrors.
Dual-path execution: mirrored requests go to a separate worker pool without KV cache warmups; responses are recorded but never promoted to shared caches.
Sampling algorithm: combine deterministic hashing of request id with a small reservoir sampler for burst capture; allows reproducible subset for A/B and unbiased statistical estimates.
Cost gate: meter tokens at mirror-time; once a tenant exhausts credit, mirror requests are dropped and a tenant-level webhook/job event is emitted.
Latency SLO: mirror path must not add more than 5ms median to production RPCs; circuit-breaker will disable mirroring synchronously when M95 tail > 100ms to protect latency-sensitive tenants.
acceptance_criteria: Config API to declare mirroring rules per-route (percent, sample-mode, tenant-credit-id) available in console and v1 API.
Mirrored requests routed to isolated replica pool with KV-disabled flag and recorded to storage for offline evaluation.
Per-tenant credit fence enforced: simulated tenant with 1k token credit stops mirroring once exhausted in test harness.
Observability: dashboards show per-tenant mirrored-token counts, latency delta, and a comparison histogram between primary and mirrored model outputs.
Automated rollback: an operator-triggered cost-circuit or an automatic condition (error rate > 1% or cost/month > budget) clears active mirroring rules and emits audit log + incident ticket.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Mirroring increases egress and GPU contention causing production tail latency spikes. Mitigation: strict worker pool isolation, token accounting, and an emergency synchronous circuit-breaker tied to P95/P99 latency metrics.
Risk: Telemetry volume grows significantly. Mitigation: sampled telemetry paths and configurable retention on heavy tenants plus push-down aggregation at the proxy level.

Risk: Billing confusion when mirrored tokens appear on usage invoices. Mitigation: create dedicated 'mirror' invoice line with zero-charge by default and communicate billing semantics in onboarding docs.

Risk: Inconsistent evaluation if mirrored path disables KV caches. Mitigation: document the difference and provide a 'warm mirror' mode (optional) that enables a per-tenant ephemeral KV only for advanced experiments.
implementation_plan: Week 1: API schema, console UX mockups, and proto for mirror-control (Priya + UX + Marco).
Week 2: Proxy skeleton, routing to isolated replica pool, and lease-based credit integration (runtime team).
Week 3: Sampling engine, reservoir sampler, deterministic-hash path, and basic observability hooks (metrics + traces).
Week 4: Telemetry aggregation, per-tenant dashboards, and simulated tenant quota tests (QA + SRE).
Week 5: Canary rollout to internal tenants, burn-in, and add automatic circuit-breaker rules.
Week 6: Ship beta with docs, billing flag gating, and run two pilot customers for shadow experiments.
test_plan: Unit tests for sampling determinism and reservoir behavior.
Integration tests: mirrored requests are logged and isolated from KV caches; use synthetic traffic to validate no cache pollution.
Load test: ramp mirrored percent to 50% for a synthetic tenant to ensure worker pool isolation prevents production degradation.
Chaos test: simulate delayed mirrored backend and verify circuit-breaker disables mirroring without affecting primary path.
rollout_strategy: Start as opt-in beta for internal org and key power-users.
Stage per-route: allow only 1% mirror by default, escalate to 5%/10% after 72h of healthy metrics.
Tenant credit default: free 10k tokens/month for early pilots; require billing contract for sustained mirrors.
Automatic rollback: immediate disable on SLO breach or cost-circuit trigger + postmortem requirement.
